values.note: Recreation.gov lists 21 sites including one group site (the Forest Service page says 26). Forest Service: max RV 35 ft; everything with wheels must fit the parking spur, no overflow parking. Catalog driveways run 28-62 ft (vehicle maximums 30-40 ft where given), though a recreation.gov notice calls the gravel spurs about 20 ft.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/235764 ('21 sites offer improved primitive camping'; notice 'All parking spurs are gravel and are large enough to accommodate an extended cab pickup truck size (approximately 20 feet in length)') + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:235764 (21 sites incl. 07-Group; Driveway Length 28-62; Max Vehicle Length 30 at 01-04, 40 at 13) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/ute-campground ('Max RV size = 35 ft'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Two pairs of vault toilets and one pressurized water station; trash collection, host, firewood for sale. No dump station.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/235764 ('There is one potable water station under pressure and two pairs of vault toilets.'; notice 'NO dump station.'; amenities Trash Collection, Host, Firewood Vender) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/ute-campground ('Vault Toilet (2)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $22 a single site, $100 the group site (Forest Service page and recreation.gov 2026-2028 rates).

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/ute-campground ('Single Site: $22 per night | Group Site: $100 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/235764/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-26 and 2027-06-05 to 2027-09-26: PeakStandardNonelectric $22, PeakGroupStandardNonelectric $100), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Sites 08-12, 17, 21, 22 and the group site are reservable on recreation.gov; the rest are first come, first served. Stay limit 28 nights at first-come sites, 12 on reserved ones. Reservation season varies by year (May 8 - Sep 26 in 2026, Jun 5 - Sep 26 in 2027).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/235764 ('Maximum stay is 28 days at first come-first serve sites. 12 days maximum stay on reservation sites.'; notice 'First Come First Served (FCFS) Campsites are also available at this campground'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 28) + recreation.gov per-site catalog https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:235764 (reservable true at 07-Group, 08-12, 17, 21, 22) + /rates (Peak Season 2027-06-05 to 2027-09-26) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/235764/month?start_date=2026-07-01T00:00:00.000Z (sites 09, 10, 12, 17 show Reserved nights in July 2026); FS page 'Make Reservations Here' links recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/235764; read 2026-10-28

values.note: May through September; recreation.gov has the exact dates (2026 season May 8 - Sep 26).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/ute-campground ('May through September. For specific open / closure dates, visit recreation.gov.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/235764/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-08 to 2026-09-26), read 2026-10-28

note: On a gentle south-facing slope under ponderosa pine just north of US-160, ~15 mi W of Pagosa Springs, facing Chimney Rock National Monument (summer guided tours; entrance 4 mi away on CO-151); gets very warm in summer. Hiking on Haystack Mountain. --Claude
